lines.text: Brb, I'll be AFK for five minutes.

data.define: Used when you leave your game or chat for a short while.

example.text: Brb, I'll be AFK for five minutes.

misuse.text: Don't say 'AFK' in a formal email.

Ejemplo: “Brb, I'll be AFK for five minutes.” (Vuelvo pronto, estaré "AFK" cinco minutos.)
